title: EconoSpec result envelope
description: What every adapter must emit for every specification, one file per specification. Adapters are compared on the union of their keys, so emitting fewer keys is a failure rather than a smaller comparison.

adapter.description: Stable identifier of the implementation, for example reference-numpy, python-statsmodels, r-base-sandwich-aer-plm.

params.description: One entry per estimated coefficient, keyed by the regressor name as written in the spec, with const for the intercept.

pvalue.description: Omitted entirely for augmented Dickey Fuller specifications, where the statistic is not Student t under the null and published tables are package specific interpolations.

scalars.description: Fit and diagnostic quantities, recomputed by each adapter from the definitions in the contract rather than read from a library attribute.
